title: Cowboys DC Christian Parker will coach from the booth rather than the sideline

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cowboys DC Christian Parker will coach from the booth rather than the sideline
sources.description: The Cowboys brought Mike Pettine in as a senior defensive assistant on Monday and that's not the only change they'll be making as they try to improve their defensive performance over the final 12 games.
